gates.name: Baseline approval
gates.exitCriteria: All decisions dispositioned; docs/schemas promoted; technical and product sign-off.

gates.name: Foundation
gates.exitCriteria: Clean clone builds; lint, typecheck, unit smoke, task validator, and CI pass.

gates.name: Contract/data
gates.exitCriteria: Domain/SQL/config/map conformance; migrations run; no hardcoded TBD.

gates.name: Identity/join
gates.exitCriteria: Guest, link/merge, world list, join, spawn, and authz tests pass.

gates.name: Runtime/persistence
gates.exitCriteria: Deterministic tick, durable command, StateView leak, crash/replay, lease tests pass.

gates.name: Core gameplay
gates.exitCriteria: FR-010 to FR-024 core rules and a 30-day bot season pass.

gates.name: Social/economy
gates.exitCriteria: Trade and alliance matrices pass, including war freeze and escrow.

gates.name: Commerce
gates.exitCriteria: Pass/shop/RevenueCat sandbox passes; web read-only; no pay-to-win.

gates.name: Web client
gates.exitCriteria: 390px E2E, visual, accessibility, reconnect, and read-only shop pass.

gates.name: Mobile
gates.exitCriteria: Android/iOS builds, native auth, IAP sandbox, safe areas, store metadata.

gates.name: Admin
gates.exitCriteria: Admin authz, audit, moderation, and no-SQL-console checks pass.

gates.name: Ops
gates.exitCriteria: Deploy, tunnel, backups, restore drill, Sentry, runbooks, security checks.

gates.name: Launch
gates.exitCriteria: 01 section 12 acceptance, store approval, legal, load/recovery, no P0/P1 defects.

decisions.name: Exact combat-power tie
decisions.recommendation: Approved 2026-10-23: defender wins; attacker loses all; defender loses 50 percent (DEFAULT, config-driven). Mutual wipe rejected.

decisions.name: 41 proposed defaults
decisions.recommendation: Approved 2026-10-23: items 1-16 and 18-41; item 17 remains TBD under D-TBD-SUPPORT. Dispositions recorded in plan/G0-baseline-approval.md.

decisions.name: Movement, recall, ability range, missile damage
decisions.recommendation: Design proposes values; engineering adds config keys.

decisions.name: Water shortage, unpaid penalty, loot gold, doctrine cost
Training costs, times, batches, slot upgrades
AI cadence, scoring, replenishment, retreat
decisions.recommendation: Design proposes values and test expectations.

decisions.name: Major battle threshold, rebel army size
Catalog, prices, refund window, receipt rules
Jurisdiction, terms, privacy, refunds, tax, age rating, deletion/export
RevenueCat project, products, entitlement IDs, prices
Runtime DB role and RLS policy
Final map values, pan/zoom, spawn geometry
season_end vs ends_at
decisions.recommendation: Recommend season_end as the single field.

decisions.name: Content-addressed config/map or stored hashes
decisions.recommendation: Recommend content-addressed IDs plus stored hashes.

decisions.name: 3-5 worlds per host
decisions.recommendation: Validate with k6; no guarantee before G11.

decisions.name: Staging environment shape
decisions.recommendation: Recommend separate Supabase project and hostname; no production data.

decisions.name: Any scope deferral
decisions.recommendation: No deferral approved. Mobile, then shop, then abilities only with explicit approval.
